summary.text: Donald Wong is a Republican state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 9th Essex District since 2011 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, he is a ranking minority member of the House Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Wong's professional experience includes owning a business.
He assumed office in 2011 and advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Joint Committee on Labor and Workforce Development and is the ranking minority member of the House Rules Committee and of the Joint Committees on Racial Equity, Civil Rights, and Inclusion, on Rules, and on Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development.
